aboutBio: I'm a Senior Software Engineer at Citi, where I build agentic AI systems, developer platforms, and enterprise applications. I enjoy turning complex workflows into reliable, useful software across AI, backend systems, and frontend architecture.
aboutParagraphs: At Citi, I built Arthur, an agentic risk-triage system, and a Model Context Protocol server used to connect internal AI applications with data. I have also worked on AI-assisted frontend migration, machine-learning infrastructure, and the Policies Portal.

Outside of work, I'm building Shadow, an AI-powered platform for source-linked GitHub repository documentation, code Q&A, Mermaid diagrams, and incremental sync. I also built a Questionnaire Aware Agent that uses RAG and MCP to analyze complex questionnaires and supporting documents. These projects bring together product-focused web development and applied AI.
I have a few go-to tools, but no forever stack. Give me a problem and the docs, and I'm happy to explore until I find the right tools for the job.

selectedWorks.title: Form Factory — Dynamic Schema Builder
selectedWorks.subtitle: Intuitive drag-and-drop form canvas with shareable validation engines
selectedWorks.description: Create customizable, dynamic forms with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface. Features typed schema generation, real-time live preview, and seamless public sharing.
selectedWorks.previewQuote: Seamless drag-and-drop canvas with instant state sharing.

deepDive.challenge: Existing form builders are either rigid and closed-source or difficult to integrate with custom validation rules.
deepDive.approach: Built a modular drag-and-drop state canvas powered by Zustand and React Hook Form, generating dynamic JSON schemas with instant reactive preview.
deepDive.discovery: Decoupling form configuration from presentation allows instant serialization and shareable hosted forms.
deepDive.impact: Enables developers and non-technical teams to compose, preview, and deploy interactive forms in seconds.

keyFeatures.title: Drag & Drop Canvas
keyFeatures.desc: Fluid reordering of text inputs, select dropdowns, toggles, and file uploads.

keyFeatures.title: Live Schema Export
keyFeatures.desc: Generates TypeScript types and Zod validation schemas on the fly.

keyFeatures.title: Zero-Config Sharing
keyFeatures.desc: Hosted shareable form links with instant submission storage.

selectedWorks.title: Spring Boot Database Validator
selectedWorks.subtitle: Open-source auto-starter ensuring database schema integrity on boot
selectedWorks.description: A lightweight Spring Boot starter that executes immediately after application context initialization to inspect database entities, detecting missing tables, column mismatches, and broken constraints before handling production traffic.
selectedWorks.previewQuote: Prevents catastrophic runtime production failures with eager boot checks.

deepDive.challenge: Microservices frequently crash minutes into production when an unmigrated database table or modified column type is hit during user requests.
deepDive.approach: Wrote a custom Spring Boot auto-configuration starter implementing ApplicationListener<ContextRefreshedEvent> that performs reflection against active JPA entities and the JDBC metadata catalogue.
deepDive.discovery: Validating schema early in the boot sequence fails fast safely, preventing corrupted state or incomplete transactions.
deepDive.impact: Adopted in microservice pipelines to guarantee schema parity before registering with service discovery.

keyFeatures.title: Eager Schema Verification
keyFeatures.desc: Fails fast at boot if database objects diverge from entity models.

keyFeatures.title: Zero Extra Code
keyFeatures.desc: Drops into any Maven pom.xml with auto-configuration enabled.

keyFeatures.title: Detailed Diagnostics
keyFeatures.desc: Prints actionable SQL diffs pinpointing missing columns or tables.

projects.title: Shadow
projects.summary: AI-powered platform that generates source-linked documentation for GitHub repositories, with Mermaid diagrams, code Q&A, and incremental sync as repositories change.
projects.storyHeading: Understand a repository through its source
storyBody: Shadow turns a GitHub repository into a navigable source of project knowledge.
It generates documentation linked back to source code, creates Mermaid diagrams, and answers questions about the codebase.
Incremental sync keeps repository knowledge current as code changes. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Inngest, and Gemini.

projects.title: Smart AI Agent
projects.summary: Autonomous AI agent that analyzes user-submitted PDF documents and executes real-time web searches to generate comprehensive, grounded intelligence.
storyBody: Traditional LLMs suffer from knowledge cutoffs and lack context on proprietary documentation. Smart AI bridges this gap.
Combines document chunking, semantic vector embeddings, and autonomous tool calling to verify facts across PDFs and live web sources.
Synthesizes citations and cross-referenced evidence into clear, actionable answers with sub-second retrieval times.

projects.title: ngx-placeholder — Open Source NPM
projects.summary: Lightweight, customizable skeleton placeholder library published on NPM for Angular applications, improving perceived performance.
storyBody: Perceived loading speed directly correlates with user conversion and bounce rates.
Developed a highly customizable Angular directive and component library providing smooth animated shimmer skeletons.
Published on the official NPM registry with thousands of downloads and zero external dependencies.

projects.title: Market — Microservices Architecture
projects.summary: High-throughput e-commerce application built using microservices architecture with User, Cart, and Product Catalog services communicating over gRPC.
storyBody: Engineered decoupled microservices using Go and gRPC for sub-millisecond serialization.
Features independent PostgreSQL databases per service, containerized orchestration with Docker, and strict protocol buffer contract enforcement.
Handles peak cart checkout spikes with non-blocking concurrency and resilient circuit breaking.

projects.title: Concurrent CLI Web Crawler
projects.summary: Fast, concurrent command-line web scraper and link graph analyzer written in Go, leveraging goroutines and channels.
storyBody: Engineered from scratch in Go to explore concurrent worker pools, rate limiting, and duplicate URL suppression via thread-safe hash maps.
Traverses domain link graphs recursively, streaming discovered endpoints and response headers directly to standard output or JSON.
Processes thousands of URLs per minute while respecting robots.txt and host rate limits.

projects.title: Finllect API Gateway & Microservices
projects.summary: Unified API gateway serving as single point of entry for all backend requests, with asynchronous message queue decoupling.
storyBody: Engineered the Finllect API Gateway to authenticate, throttle, and route incoming requests across User, Transaction, and Coupon microservices.
Built asynchronous communication pipelines enabling decoupled and non-blocking interaction between financial modules.
Also developed an internal SlackBot for real-time transactional activity notifications, widely adopted by the executive team.

Built an automated CI/CD build and deployment pipeline using Jenkins and Docker containers.
Automated manual build and deployment steps to make release cycles more efficient.
Built modular RESTful services in Node.js and Express with MongoDB.
Developed capabilities for automated financial-goal tracking and user expense categorization.
Built and maintained internal tools at Delta Force NIT Trichy as a full-stack developer.
